description:
The Evanstonian is an upscale independent hotel.
When a guest calls room service at The Evanstonian, the room-service manager takes down the order.
She then submits an order ticket to the kitchen to begin preparing the food.
She also gives an order to the sommelier (i.e., the wine waiter) to fetch wine from the cellar and to prepare any other alcoholic beverages.
Eighty percent of room-service orders include wine or some other alcoholic beverage.
Finally, she assigns the order to the waiter.
While the kitchen and the sommelier are doing their tasks, the waiter readies a cart (i.e., puts a tablecloth on the cart and gathers silverware).
The waiter is also responsible for nonalcoholic drinks.
Once the food, wine, and cart are ready, the waiter delivers it to the guest's room.
After returning to the room-service station, the waiter debits the guest's account.
The waiter may wait to do the billing if he has another order to prepare or deliver.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/evanstonian/room-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RoomServiceCall" name="Room-service order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivery" name="Room-service delivery"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room service order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_RoomServiceCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitKitchenTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FetchWine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitToBill</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RoomServiceCall" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RoomServiceCall" messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down order"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_OrderSommelier" name="Order alcoholic beverages from sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Begin preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholSplit" name="Does the order include alcoholic beverages?" default="Flow_NoAlcohol"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchWine" name="Fetch wine from cellar"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol" name="Prepare other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" name="Complete beverage branch"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareCart" name="Prepare cart with tablecloth and silverware"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Food, beverages, and cart ready"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order to guest's room">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Delivery" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Return to room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingChoice" name="Is there another order to prepare or deliver?" default="Flow_BillNow"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WaitToBill" name="Wait until other order work is complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Continue to billing"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Debit guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderComplete" name="Account debited"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" targetRef="Task_OrderSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_OrderSommelier" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholSplit" targetRef="Task_FetchWine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${order.includesAlcoholicBeverages}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAlcohol" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_FetchWine" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCart" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_BillingChoice"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingChoice" targetRef="Task_WaitToBill">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${anotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillNow" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingChoice" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_WaitToBill" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="End_OrderComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Evanstonian" name="The Evanstonian" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestCall" name="Room-service call" sourceRef="Participant_Guest" targetRef="Start_RoomServiceCall" messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Order delivered" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Participant_Guest" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
